note_on_style: Series uses halftone engravings with night/light imagery. SVG illustrations (public/images/illustrations/euangelion-homepage-engraving-*.svg) provide the closest existing style reference within the curated library.

series_header.rationale: Genesis creation imagery with light-dark duality directly echoes John 3's light-darkness theological tension.
Explicit Nicodemus night scene—the exact opening narrative of John 3, establishes nocturnal seeking motif.
Window framing light at threshold; captures night-into-day transition and threshold imagery central to John 3.

day_1_secret_seeker_by_night.rationale: Perfect match: Nicodemus approaching Jesus by night is the exact narrative of John 3:1–2; embodies secret seeking under cover of darkness.
Figure at window in darkness, lamp-lit prayer; captures figure-at-threshold and night-vigil elements of secret seeking.
Lamp illuminating scripture in darkness; evokes nocturnal spiritual hunger and questioning approach.

day_2_birth_from_above.rationale: Newborn lamb in straw; directly visualizes 'born anew' concept with fresh-life and light imagery.
Genesis day-one light separating from darkness; primordial birth of creation echoes spiritual rebirth metaphor.
Nativity birth in light; foreshadows Christ-as-light and the 'born of water and Spirit' theme.

day_3_wind_water_ruach.rationale: Dry bones revived by Spirit breath (Ezekiel); directly parallels John 3:8 wind metaphor and ruach (breath/spirit) imagery.
Wind and water storm calmed by Christ; combines breath-wind and water imagery central to John 3:5–8.
Baptism in flowing water; water and Spirit union of John 3:5 ('born of water and Spirit').

day_4_the_leap_faith.rationale: Jacob's ladder ascending from earth to heaven; visualizes crossing chasm via trust and vertical leap of faith.
Figure reaching across a gap to help; embodies hand-reaching-across-chasm and trust-bridge themes.
Extended hand reaching; suggests the gap-crossing and hand-reaching imagery of faith leaping.

day_5_bronze_serpent.rationale: Bronze serpent on pole (Numbers 21); direct scriptural image referenced in John 3:14 as type of Christ's lifting up.
Moses' staff serpent (Exodus); OT type of the brazen serpent; embodies staff-lifted imagery.
Vine with lifted branches; symbolic of lifting-up motif, foreshadows John 3:14 'lifted up' language.

day_6_cosmic_rescue_kosmos.rationale: Fruit of Spirit imagery; represents God's love reaching and transforming the kosmos through Christ.
Christ as pilgrim reaching toward world; embodies cosmic rescue and arms-wide embrace of redemption.
Light radiating over creation; captures cosmic scope of God's light reaching the world (John 3:16–17).

day_7_light_breaking.rationale: Day separating from darkness at creation; mirrors John 3:19–21 light-breaking-through-darkness final image.
Dawn breaking at moment of conversion and rescue; sunrise after night, liberation imagery of light victory.
Empty cross with light breaking; suggests resurrection dawn and Christ's light triumphing over darkness.

summary_stats.key_findings: Existing devotional library has strong Old Testament typology matches (creation light, bronze serpent, dry bones revival, Jacob's ladder) and specific Nicodemus-night image. Primary gaps are (1) no halftone series header with blue/cream palette, (2) no explicit hand-reaching-gap leap-of-faith image, (3) no arms-wide-open cosmic rescue image. SVG illustrations (euangelion-homepage-engraving-*.svg) provide the closest style anchor for any new generation work.
